meta.label: MEASURED — OAE Agricultural Statistics of Thailand
parse_notes: Farm household income: NOT present in this yearbook edition -- the 2567/2024 Agricultural Statistics of Thailand table of contents has no household-income section (sections are: Food crops, Oil crops, Vegetables, Fruit trees, Perennial trees, Flowering plants, Livestock, Fishery, Forestry, Climate & Irrigation, Land utilization & tenure, Value of exports/imports, Agricultural economic index). Existing source-data/nabc_agri.json ('farmer_family') is the closer proxy already in the repo.

Province-table area/production/yield cells are in RAW units (rai, ton, kg/rai) as printed. The national farmgate_price_national_timeseries series are in the yearbook's THOUSANDS units (1,000 rai / 1,000 ton) except yield (kg/rai) and price (Baht/kg or Baht/ton) -- do not mix the two scales without dividing/multiplying by 1000.

'p'/'f'/'r' flags (preliminary/forecast/revised) that the PDF renders as a stray prefix line on some cells were stripped and the underlying number kept; provenance flag logged per-cell below where it occurred (mostly the newest 1-2 years of each national series).

Row 'row_type' in the province tables: 'province' = an actual province row; 'region_total' = one of the 4 OAE regions (เหนือ/North, ตะวันออกเฉียงเหนือ/Northeast, กลาง/Central, ใต้/South) subtotal; 'national_total' = whole-kingdom row (รวมทั้งประเทศ). Keep these separate from province rows when summing. row_type is classified off the ASCII English name column (reliable) rather than the Thai string, because on some pages (e.g. sugarcane p.70-71) pdfplumber's Thai text extraction reorders combining vowel/tone-mark glyphs on the region-subtotal label (prints as 'ตะวนั ออกเฉยี งเหนอื' instead of 'ตะวันออกเฉียงเหนือ') -- a PDF-extraction font artifact, not a data error. province_th is stored exactly as extracted (including this artifact where it occurs) per the 'as printed' instruction; do not use province_th for exact-string joins without also checking province_en / row_type.

Rice province tables came from the OAE catalog's own per-province CSV export (dataset dataoae1104), not the yearbook PDF: main-season (ข้าวนาปี) crop-year 2567 covers all 77 provinces; second-season (ข้าวนาปรัง) crop-year 2568 (forecast, flagged in source) covers 73 provinces -- 4 provinces have no second-season rice rows (no error, they largely do not grow it: e.g. far-south / non-irrigated areas).
Sugarcane province table has NO 'planted_area_rai' column in the source (only harvested area is tabulated by OAE for sugarcane) -- do not treat its absence as a parse failure.

Maize province table 'planted_area_rai'/'harvested_area_rai' are for the COMBINED crop (all rounds); the yearbook also has a by-round breakdown (Table 1.11, rain-fed vs dry-season) at PDF pages 59-63 which was NOT extracted in this pass (out of scope -- flagged as a gap below).

NOT extracted in this pass (time-boxed ~40 tool calls): rice PDF province table (Table 1.3, PDF pages 33-44, redundant with the CSV pull above), maize by-round split (Table 1.11), soybean/coconut/vegetables/fruit-tree province tables (present in the yearbook, sections II-VI), livestock counts (Section VII), land utilization & tenure by province (Section XI, PDF pages 171-184), and export/import values (Section XII). All are present in the same PDF (source-data/raw/oae-agstats/agstats_yearbook_2567.pdf, 228 pages) for a future pass if needed.
